Title: A. MSBA Board Policy Updates 2025-A, 2025-B and 2025-C

fields.Content: Casey Klapmeyer, Deputy Superintendent

The Missouri School Board Association (MSBA) has provided member districts policy updates 2025-A, 2025-B, and 2025-C.  These updates have been made based on federal and state regulation or legislative changes.  All three of these updates have been presented to the Board's Policy Committee at their June 9 and August 7, 2025, meetings. The Committee has approved them for a Second Read and Adoption.  Attached are the Board Memo, three Board Briefs that provide a quick overview of the changes in each of the updates, and draft policies that reflect the actual changes recommended by MSBA.
The superintendent recommends approval of MSBA Board Policy updates 2025-A, 2025-B, and 2025-C as presented.

Title: B. Board Policy IGBH: Program for English Language Learners

fields.Content: Casey Klapmeyer, Deputy Superintendent

This is a district initiated update to align with feedback from the Missouri Department of Elementary and Secondary's review of our ELL Policy.  This revision updates the district's EL Program Coordinator to the correct position, Director of Extended Learning.
The superintendent recommends approval of the revised Board Policy IGBH as presented.

fields.Content:
Public comment is open to any community member with a 2-minute limit.

Comments must pertain to an item on the agenda, per Board Policy BDA.

To be on the list to provide public comment at this meeting, email the Board Secretary ramandah@hickmanmills.org before this meeting’s Call to Order.

Public comment is not considered an inquiry and does not require any of the following: two-way conversation, Board response, timelines, motion for voting, or immediate resolution.
